Week 19 Module Map: The Mexican-American War

Quarter 3: The Price of Union · Geography pass: the Nueces Strip, resolved by force

Annexation left Texas's southwestern border undefined. This week you see how a war fixed it.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: President Polk and The Nueces Crisis
  • Lesson 2: Winfield Scott Captures the Halls of Montezuma

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 19 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 19 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 19 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Courage: notice it in Jack Hays, Samuel Walker, and the soldiers of Scott's army.
